formulas.morale_pressure: casualty_pressure + commander_loss + flank_rear_pressure + isolation + supply_failure + fear_effects - rally - cohesion_support

rule: Morale changes require a registered trigger; narration cannot move morale without state update.

trigger_formulas.commander_loss: 25 if primary commander incapacitated; 10 if deputy incapacitated; 0 otherwise
trigger_formulas.flank_rear_pressure: 15 for confirmed flank penetration; 25 for confirmed rear penetration
trigger_formulas.isolation: 20 if cut off from command and withdrawal route; 0 otherwise
trigger_formulas.rally: min(30,0.20*leader_leadership + 0.10*leader_presence) when a legal rally action succeeds

transition_rule: Calculate effective morale after each registered trigger bundle. The threshold state becomes authoritative immediately; recovery requires a legal rally/rest/process event.
